page: Microsoft Azure M96lds_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by dedicated x86_64 Intel processor architecture, supplying 96 dedicated vCPUs. With a substantial memory allocation of 1536.0 GB of RAM, the system delivers a high ratio of 16.0 GB per vCPU, placing it firmly in the heavy memory tier of cloud infrastructure.

Local ephemeral storage is bundled directly with the instance, providing 3544 GB of high-speed NVMe SSD capacity. The instance also supports Premium Storage integration for external persistent disk demands. No dedicated graphics processors or accelerators are included, with the GPU count standing at zero. Additionally, complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included with this instance type.

From an architectural standpoint, the combination of massive system memory, dense dedicated core count, and local NVMe SSD storage makes the M96lds_v4 cost-efficient for heavy workloads that require vast working sets residing directly in RAM without the overhead of horizontal sharding. However, organizations with GPU-dependent computing requirements or those needing AVX acceleration instruction flags must look to alternate configurations.

Microsoft Azure M96lds_v4 is best suited for enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, massive in-memory databases such as SAP HANA, relational database systems requiring substantial buffer pools, and large-scale data processing pipelines.
